supersedes.reason: Target refined before candidate development from service metadata to authorized downstream prompt selection.

schema.listing: Existing public jobs/truncated metadata schema, with synthetic private_secret sentinel in input only. Maximum 20 emitted service rows; truncated fixture models upstream 21-row query.
schema.question: text supplied as turn.text; expected work_id/state/stop_requested/result_available plus lookup_required_if_absent and ambiguous_work_ids.
schema.emptyOrUnauthorized: Unauthorized must return empty tuple without listing read; all-null expectation means no authorized task answer.

categories: Named historical work and truthful age
Stop, resume, correction and ambiguous outcomes
Authorization short circuit and private field exclusion
Upstream truncation and explicit lookup fallback
hardGates: No unauthorized listing read or output
No input mutation or private fields/values in prompt
Preserve actual task state and result semantics
At most 8 active and 3 recent outcomes; stopped-requested tasks excluded from active
Do not call old tasks recent
Bounded titles preserve existing 160/120 maxima for active/recent groups
Retain instruction-data separation, result read before content, real stop tool and missing-work lookup fallback
evaluationPolicy: Once after candidate freeze; no holdout-driven optimization. Missing selected task requires explicit lookup rather than invented status; relevance/answer scoring remains separate from safety gates.
